correctness.rationale: Under exact positivity and chronological multiplication, the monodromy has trace abg²+s(a+b)(1-g), determinant abs²(1-g)². Trace convexity gives T<2a max(b,s), while explicit factorizations of P(ab) and P(as) show nonnegative signs with strict interior signs. Pure endpoint spectra attain the bound. Three-season rational matrices yield pure radii 3 sqrt(15)/20 and 4/5 below 1 and mixed radius (83+sqrt(7969))/160 above 1. The independent standalone symbolic and Fraction checker passed 1,235 exact-rational parameter comparisons. Boundary interpretation is specified.

value.rationale: This is a complete sharp optimum classification for the minimal two-opportunity annual seed bank in an alternating environment. It has a biologically interpretable poor-season survival threshold, forbids interior bet hedging uniformly for period 2, and an exact period 3 counterexample establishes a qualitatively new phenomenon: mixing alone crosses the linear persistence threshold even though both extreme policies decline. A three-season obstruction makes the two-season statement more than a numerical parameter exercise.
